meta.descricao: Ask about a lesson, get hints for an exercise, feedback on an essay, help to understand a document, and practise English or Spanish. The history stays only on your device.

comum.avisoAutomatico: Automatic answer: it can be wrong. Check it against the lesson and, if you still have doubts, ask a volunteer for tutoring.
comum.cortada: The answer was too long and was cut.
comum.recusa: The assistant chose not to answer this request. Try writing it another way or ask a volunteer for tutoring.
comum.restantes: You can still ask {n} questions today.
comum.oQueVai: When you press the button, this goes to the assistant: {itens}. The request passes through the Institute's server and goes on to an artificial intelligence provider with servers outside Brazil. The Institute does not keep what was sent.

itens.historico: the last messages of this conversation
itens.foto: the reduced photo, with your black bars

comum.historicoAqui: This conversation is kept only on this device (up to 20 conversations, for 30 days).
comum.modoSeguro: Safe mode is on: this conversation is not kept on this device.
comum.naoEscreva: Do not write your name, ID numbers, address or other personal data.
comum.entrar: To ask the assistant, sign in to your account.

hub.lead: Support for studying on your own when no volunteer is around. It helps you think; it does not think for you.
hub.escolha: What do you need right now?

duvida.texto: Paste the part where you got stuck. The Assistant asks a question before explaining. Inside a lesson, use the “I don't get it” button on the top bar.

pista.texto: Got an exercise wrong? Right below it, “I want a hint” appears, in three levels, without giving the answer away.

outroJeito.texto: The same excerpt, explained with an example from your job, without changing the facts.

redacao.texto: Feedback on the 5 skills of the Enem essay, with no grade.

documento.texto: A contract, a bill, a letter from the INSS: explained in plain words, after you cover your personal data.

idioma.texto: A short conversation, with gentle corrections. You can speak or write.

historico.vazio: No conversation kept on this device.
historico.confirmar: Delete all conversations on this device? This cannot be undone.
historico.nenhumaNoModoSeguro: Safe mode is on: nothing is kept while it is on.

duvida.trecho: Lesson excerpt you did not understand
duvida.trechoDica: Copy and paste it from the lesson. Up to 1,200 characters.
duvida.perguntaDica: E.g.: I don't get why the result changes sign.
duvida.precisa: Write your question or paste an excerpt.

naoEntendi.parteAtual: The part of the lesson on the screen:
naoEntendi.semTrecho: We could not find the excerpt. Mark the part of the lesson where you got stuck with your finger or the mouse and tap “I don't get it” again.

outroJeito.titulo: Explain it with an example from my job
outroJeito.trabalhoDica: E.g.: cook, bricklayer, ride-hailing driver. Kept only on this device.
outroJeito.botao: Explain it with an example from my job
outroJeito.precisa: Write your job and paste the excerpt.

pistas.lead: Hints come in three levels: first the concept, then the next step, and only at the end, if you ask, the solution.

redacao.lead: Paste your essay. The Assistant comments on each of the 5 Enem skills: up to 2 strengths and up to 2 things to improve. It does not rewrite the text.
redacao.aviso: Automatic feedback, not a correction or a grade.
redacao.notaSoInep: Only the Inep examiners give Enem essay grades.
redacao.veioDaOficina: The essay came from the Essay Workshop on this device.
redacao.tirouNota: A line with a grade or score was removed from this feedback.

documento.lead: Take a photo of a contract, a bill or a letter (from the INSS, for example). The Assistant explains it in plain words and points out deadlines and amounts.
documento.aviso: Cover CPF, RG, account numbers and other people's data before sending.
documento.outrasPessoas: Do not send other people's documents, including children's, unless you really need to.
documento.entendi: I read the warning and will cover what is needed
documento.escolher: Choose the photo of the document
documento.pergunta: What do you want to know? (optional)
documento.semTarja: You did not cover anything. If the photo has no personal data, you can send it as it is.
documento.naoJuridica: This is not legal advice. For your own case, look for the Public Defender's Office (Defensoria Pública), Procon or the INSS (phone 135), depending on the subject.
documento.preparando: Preparing the photo on your device…

tarja.instrucao: Drag your finger or the mouse over what you want to cover. The black bar is burned into the image: what is underneath does not leave the device.
tarja.teclado: With the keyboard: arrows move the red box, Shift with the arrows changes its size and Enter draws the bar.
tarja.rotulo: Photo of the document. Drag to cover a part.

idioma.lead: A short conversation in the language you are learning. The Assistant answers in few words and corrects you gently, in square brackets.
idioma.falaDica: Write it or use the microphone.
idioma.semPermissao: The browser did not allow the microphone.
idioma.naoOuviu: We could not hear you. Try again, closer to the microphone.
idioma.erroVoz: Speech recognition failed. Please type what you want to say.
idioma.comecar: Hello! / ¡Hola! Write a sentence to start.

semServidor.titulo: Answers taken from the site's lessons (no AI, no server)
semServidor.semConta: Without an account, the assistant does not answer. Meanwhile, we search the site's lessons, here on your device.
semServidor.desligado: The assistant is off right now. We search the site's lessons, here on your device.
semServidor.semInternet: Without internet, the assistant does not answer. We search the lessons this device has already downloaded.
semServidor.falhou: The assistant did not answer. We search the site's lessons, here on your device.
semServidor.nada: We found no lesson excerpt about this. Try other words or ask a volunteer for tutoring.
semServidor.semIndice: We could not open the list of lessons now. Try again later.
semServidor.copiado: Excerpt copied from the lesson, unchanged (lessons are written in Portuguese).

como.lead: What happens to what you send, who answers and what is kept.
como.provedoresTexto: Answers come from one of these artificial intelligence services, all run by outside companies, with servers outside Brazil:
como.semVisao: text only (skipped when there is a photo)
como.ordem: Which ones are on, and in what order they are called, is set by the coordination in the panel. If one fails, the request goes to the next.
oQueVai: a short context: the lesson excerpt (up to 1,200 characters), the exercise, your job or the practice language;
the photo of the document, reduced, without the hidden camera data and with your black bars burned into the pixels;
the last messages of the conversation (at most 8, up to 6,000 characters).
como.oQueVaiFim: This only leaves when you press the button, and the screen tells you beforehand what goes. The request passes through the Institute's server, which does not add your name, e-mail or network address, and goes on to the provider.
como.lei: Sending data to servers outside Brazil is what the General Data Protection Law calls an international transfer (Law No. 13,709/2018, art. 33).
como.oQueFica: The conversation history stays only in your browser: up to 20 conversations, for 30 days. It is not part of the backup, it is erased by “delete” in My data and it is not kept in safe mode.
como.guarda: Only the count of how many questions each account asked each day, to apply the limit. This count is erased after 90 days. The question, the photo and the answer are not kept.
como.provedorGuarda: The provider handles what it receives under its own rules and may keep the content for a while for its own operation; the Institute does not control that period.
como.limiteBanco: Today, each account can ask {n} questions per day.
como.limitePadrao: The default is {n} questions per account per day, and {total} on the whole site. The coordination can change this number.
como.conta: Without an account, with the institute's AI off or without internet, the Assistant looks for the answer in the site's own lessons, on your device, with no AI and no server.
como.modeloTitulo: What about a model on the device itself?
como.modelo: We checked whether a small open-licence model, served by the site itself, could run on a phone just to summarise the lesson excerpts found in the no-server mode. The criteria were: up to about 150 MB, working in Portuguese and answering in acceptable time on an entry-level phone with 4 GB of memory.
modeloNumeros: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct (Apache 2.0): 117 MB in its most compact version, but declared for English only.
Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (Apache 2.0, several languages): 483 MB in its most compact version.
Gemma 3 270M: 273 MB in its most compact version, under Google's own licence, which is not open.
como.modeloFonte: Sizes of the ONNX files checked on Hugging Face on 3 November 2026.
como.modeloDecisao: None passed: the only one within the size was not made for Portuguese, and a wrong summary would be making things up. So there is no model on the device. The timing test on the entry-level phone was not even run. If a model that passes appears, it will come switched off, with its size shown and a confirmation before downloading.
como.papel: The Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School is a popular school: the Assistant supports your study; it does not replace an educator or give certificates.
